title: Jerkin' Footwork Tutorial : Moves and how to put them together

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down each footwork move step by step, explaining foot placement and direction clearly. He demonstrates moves slowly and then speeds them up before showing how to combine them.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces himself and explains that this is a full tutorial for jerkin' footwork.
Teaches how to incorporate the heel-toe with the Melbourne shuffle.
Teaches how to put the heel-toe step into the heel-toe.
Teaches how to put the criss-cross with the steez step.

metaphors: think of it as a line

steps_taught.name: Advanced Reject
steps_taught.description: A normal reject where you twist your foot inwards on your toes.

steps_taught.name: Melbourne Shuffle
steps_taught.description: Pick your non-dominant foot, make a twist on your heel, then toe, heel, toe.

steps_taught.name: Heel-Toe
steps_taught.description: Carve the heel by twisting in and out with one foot while swinging the other foot up and down.

steps_taught.name: Heel-Toe Step
steps_taught.description: Carve with your heel again, then carve with your toe right after, followed by a step.

steps_taught.name: Criss-Cross
steps_taught.description: Keep feet separated, put them together, then separate them and cross the opposite way.

steps_taught.name: Steez Step
steps_taught.description: Turn to one side, then jump to the other side.

what_works: Breaking down complex moves into smaller parts like heel and toe combinations
Showing combinations after individual moves are taught
what_hinders: Lack of consistent counting or rhythm accompaniment during explanations

quotes.text: This is called the Melbourne shuffle.
This is a move you've probably seen before. It's called the heel-toe.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates the advanced reject footwork facing forward from a waist-down view.
Teacher demonstrates the Melbourne shuffle focusing on heel and toe articulation.
Teacher demonstrates the heel-toe footwork pattern.
Teacher demonstrates the criss-cross footwork sequence.

extraction.distinctive_method: Isolating movements by explaining individual foot parts (heel, toe) sequentially before combining them into a full step.
